sentences.c: My happiness project has turned me into a sleep zealot.
sentences.cn: 我的快乐计划曾把我变成了一个十足的睡眠爱好者。

synos.cn: 狂热者；犹太教狂热信徒

trans.cn: Nhiệt tình, vui vẻ, tích cực
trans.cn_source: 热心的，热情的，积极的

trans.cn: (danh từ) (Zealous) (English) Zeles (tên cá nhân)
trans.cn_source: 【名】 （Zealous）（英）泽勒斯（人名）

sentences.c: To make up for the mediocrity, zealous parents send their kids to the expensive cram schools.
sentences.cn: 为了弥补平庸，积极的父母把孩子送到昂贵的补习班。

sentences.c: She was a zealous worker for charity.
sentences.cn: 她是个热衷于慈善事业的工作者。

sentences.c: But other European Banks were not so zealous.
sentences.cn: 但其它欧洲银行就没那么积极了。
